notes: Southern Baptist church on the far east side. Resolved on 2026-09-10: the church website is etbc.org, the street address is 9100 E Speedway Blvd, Tucson AZ 85710 (from the church's own contact page), and John Anderson is confirmed as Senior Pastor on the church's own staff page, which verifies the earlier directory-sourced name. The staff page describes his preaching as 'straight-forward, giving practical application to today's complex issues'. He appears to be the only regular preacher: the only other man on the staff page with any pastoral description is Carl Erbe, 'Online Worship Associate', a self-supporting missionary to Japan who the page says 'has also assumed minor duties as an associate pastor' - that is not evidence of regular preaching, so he is not listed. The worship-leader post is vacant. SBC affiliation is confirmed by both the SBC.net directory and the Arizona Mission Network (the SBC state convention). Practical note: etbc.org is a Finalweb JS-rendered site and plain HTTP fetches return an empty shell, so use a real browser to read its pages. YouTube channel UCz1YFv2AqbAippXPTOjcn0w resolves to the handle @etbcaz; caption availability not yet checked. Coordinates missing - run tools/geocode.py.
